🏈Football Legacy  [🔥SEASON 1🔥]

Early Access Warning:

⚡Welcome to our Early Access phase!

⚠️Caution: Bugs Ahead❗

This game is in the early stages of development, and while we've done our best to squash as many bugs as possible, there may still be some lurking around. You might encounter unexpected behavior, glitches, or other issues as you explore the game.

🆕Daily Updates Await!

To enhance your gaming experience, we're dedicated to providing frequent updates. Our team is hard at work refining features, improving performance, and addressing any issues reported by our Early Access players. Expect something new every day!

📝Your Feedback Matters!

As a valued member of our Early Access community, your feedback is invaluable. Help us shape the future of the game by reporting any bugs you encounter and sharing your suggestions for improvement. Together, we'll make this game the best it can be.
